methods.label: Recognize the perpendicular symbol
methods.explanation: The symbol for perpendicularity is \(\perp\), written as \(a\perp b\). The symbol \(\parallel\) means parallel.
methods.levelReason: Requires only recognition of the Grade 7 notation for perpendicular lines.
